llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了粉末重复使用对Ti-6Al-4V选区激光熔化力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构设计、应力遮挡或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding evaluation, no biomedical context, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究粉末重复使用对选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过重复使用粉末制备试样并进行拉伸和硬度测试。
summary_zh.result: 粉末重复使用导致力学性能轻微下降。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试结果进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of powder reuse on the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated using reused powder and subjected to tensile and hardness testing.
summary_en.result: Reusing powder led to a slight degradation in mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental mechanical testing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文是关于全髋关节置换术前进行渐进式抗阻训练的临床随机对照试验，与应力遮挡、微动、FEA等生物力学方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial on preoperative exercise therapy, containing no implant design, finite element analysis, stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究术前抗阻训练对全髋关节置换术后功能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对随机对照试验进行二次分析，比较训练组与对照组的结局。
summary_zh.result: 术前抗阻训练可改善术后早期力量恢复，但对长期功能无显著影响。
summary_zh.validation: 基于随机对照试验的临床数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate whether progressive resistance training before total hip arthroplasty improves postoperative functional outcomes.
summary_en.method: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial comparing a preoperative resistance training group with a control group.
summary_en.result: Preoperative resistance training led to improved early postoperative strength but no significant long-term functional benefits.
summary_en.validation: Clinical trial data with randomization and standard outcome measures.

papers.title: On the chemical composition, structure and mechanical properties of alloy EP648 fabricated by deformation, project die casting and selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The paper studies chemical composition, structure and mechanical properties of the heat-resistant nickel EP648 alloy obtained by deformation, die project casting and selective laser melting. It is shown that the deformed material is characterized by low porosity, high impact strength and ductility, the cast material has large grains, high long-term strength and low-cycle fatigue. The material obtained by selective laser melting is characterized by an increased content of oxygen and nitrogen, fine-grain structure with large variation in grain size strongly expressed and heredity, and also high short-term strength.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是镍基高温合金的增材制造，与生物医用植入物或骨组织工程无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies a nickel-based superalloy for high-temperature applications, with no biomedical context, porous structure, stress shielding, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究变形、铸造和SLM三种工艺下镍基合金EP648的性能差异。
summary_zh.method: 对比分析变形、铸造和SLM制备的合金的化学成分、微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: SLM材料具有细晶、高短时强度，但氧氮含量高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过化学成分分析、微观结构观察和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the chemical composition, microstructure, and mechanical properties of nickel-based superalloy EP648 fabricated by deformation, casting, and selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were prepared by three routes: deformation, die casting, and SLM, then characterized by chemical analysis, microscopy, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: SLM material exhibited fine grains, high short-term strength, but increased oxygen and nitrogen content compared to deformed and cast counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through chemical composition analysis, microstructural observation, and standard mechanical tests.
